android_mechanism: List rows eagerly created / not recycled while scrolling
bug_description: The song search-result tab renders results with a plain ForEach inside List. Loading several result pages (30 per page) eagerly creates SongCard components for every accumulated result — including off-screen ones — and rebuilds them as the array grows, slowing search-result display and scrolling.
fix_summary: Results render through LazyForEach backed by a LazyData data source (already used elsewhere in the app), so rows are created on demand and recycled.
trigger_steps: Search a broad keyword (e.g. a popular artist) yielding many pages of results.
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched).
Load 5+ result pages via the load-more button, then scroll the list up and down.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: (a) UI-thread CPU from results display to end of scroll; (b) count of SongCard component builds; (c) dropped frames while scrolling.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed builds all accumulated rows (150+ after 5 pages) at once; fixed builds only visible rows. unfixed first-paint after load-more and scroll CPU measurably higher; more jank frames.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 ace app sched graphic -o /data/local/tmp/cm_searchlist.chtrace
